title: A startup that builds other startups raised $100M, and is all-in on physical AI | TechCrunch
summary: Founder and CEO John Kuolt told TechCrunch that Vantora is moving toward a “proprietary M&A pipeline.” This means Vantora will still build startups for its corporate partners, which invest in the ventures and serve as their first customers.
